900.3.10(701).explanation: Exception RD 701 sets a 0.9 m minimum side yard setback and a 4.5 m minimum setback from a side lot line abutting a street. On Conlins Rd., Morrish Rd., Meadowvale Rd., Military Trail, Ellesmere Rd., Morningside Ave. and Highway 2 the front setback is measured from the original road centre line (22.0 m, 25.0 m or 30.0 m), which we cannot check. These lands must also comply with exception 900.3.10(1462).

900.3.10(1410).explanation: Exception RD 1410 lets a detached house built before October 15, 1953, on a lot with a permitted FSI of 0.6, add a rear addition up to a total FSI of 0.69 under conditions on floor levels, side wall alignment and the age of prior additions (not checked). Raised front- or rear-yard platforms may not encroach into the required setback, and lots with 7.6 m of frontage or less may not have a vehicle entrance through the front wall. Two sections of former City of Toronto By-law 438-86 also prevail.

900.3.10(123).explanation: Exception RD 123 sets a 7.5 m minimum front yard setback, a 1.2 m minimum side yard setback and a 5.7 m minimum setback from a side lot line abutting a street. Minimum lot frontage and lot area are whatever existed when By-law 569-2013 was enacted, and along Livingston Rd., Guildwood Parkway and Galloway Rd. buildings must be 22 m from the original road centreline (not checked). These lands must also comply with exception 900.3.10(1462).
